text: Close your eyes for 20 seconds. How many different sounds can you identify?
hook: When we close our eyes, our ears pay even closer attention. Let's try it!

text: Find a loud sound and a soft sound at home. Which one do you like more?
hook: Sounds can be loud like thunder or soft like a whisper.

text: Go outside or to a window and listen for 1 minute. What nature sounds do you hear?
hook: Wind, birds, rain... nature has its own orchestra!

text: With an adult, try to identify 3 foods by smell, with your eyes closed.
hook: Your nose can recognize thousands of different smells. Let's test yours!

text: Smell a flower or a fruit. How would you describe that smell in your own words?
hook: Every flower and every fruit has its own special smell. Can you describe it?

text: Walk around your house and find the nicest smell and the strangest one.
hook: Every room in the house has different smells. Let's be smell detectives!

text: Find something rough, something soft, and something cold at home.
hook: Your hands can feel very different textures. Let's explore!

text: With your eyes closed, ask an adult to give you 3 objects to touch and guess what they are.
hook: Without seeing, our hands become our eyes. Can you guess them all?

text: Carefully touch 3 things with different temperatures: cold, warm, and hot.
hook: Your skin can feel if something is cold or hot. Always ask an adult for help with hot things!

text: With an adult, taste something sweet, something sour, and something salty.
hook: Your tongue can taste different flavors: sweet, sour, salty, and bitter.

text: With your eyes closed, taste a food an adult picks and try to guess what it is.
hook: Without seeing the food, your taste buds have to work alone. Do you think you can guess?

text: Taste your favorite fruit and describe its flavor in 3 words.
hook: Describing a flavor in words is a fun challenge. Let's try it!

text: Count how many red objects you can see around you right now.
hook: Our eyes see millions of colors, but sometimes we only notice one at a time.

text: Look closely at a leaf or a stone for 1 minute. What details do you find?
hook: When we look carefully, we discover details that go unnoticed at first glance.

text: Find something very far from you and something very close to you.
hook: Our eyes can focus on things near and far. Let's test that magic!
